small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE
title: Liquidity guard on the pair's TRADED candles (non-zero-volume median), momentum and reversion books
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1 weights for the reversion arms, momentum model-free. Nothing adopted.
why: preregistration_liq.json's guard (signal candle quote volume > the pair's 30-day median over ALL candles) refused 2.8% of momentum signals: binance.us thin pairs have 46-63% zero-volume 15m candles, so that median is ~0. Offline (full-sample, seen): the bottom quartile of signal-candle liquidity earns ~0 in both books (momentum -490 USDT; cs_aro 184, late -312) and cs_aro's within-pair top third holds 77% of its P&L with both halves positive. This replaces the baseline with the median of the pair's NON-ZERO-volume candles (its typical traded candle).
threshold_choice: min_ratio 5.0, chosen from the REFUSAL distribution only (no P&L read under this measure): at 1.0 the non-zero guard still refuses only 3.1% (st_g24_mom_s4k), 2.4% (cs_aro), 2.4% (cs_aro_all3k) of existing trades' signal candles -- inert again. At 5.0 it refuses 22.2% / 25.6% / 25.7% (late 20.0% / 24.7% / 24.8%) -- the bottom quartile the offline tables flagged. Per pair at 5.0 the refusals are uneven (SOL 45-49%, XRP 16-34%, DOT 9-10%): the liquid pairs' signals sit closer to their own typical traded candle.

arms.st_g24_mom_liqnz: SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24 (startup 4096) + LIQUIDITY_GUARD {window 2880, min_ratio 5, nonzero}: keep a signal only where the signal candle's quote volume > 5 x the median quote volume of the pair's non-zero-volume candles in the trailing 2880 bars (current included)
arms.cs_aro_s4k: NNNC_CS_ARO with startup_candle_count 4096 (MODEL_TRAINED_WITH 64: cs_aro's own weights, same model key verified), no guard: the warm-up null
arms.cs_aro_all3k_s4k: NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K with startup 4096 (same weights), no guard: the warm-up null

code: utils/LiquidityGuardMixin.py ('nonzero' option, default off; utils/tests/test_liquidity_guard.py); SimpleTrigger/SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24_LiqNZ.py; NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_{S4K,LIQNZ}.py, NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K_{S4K,LIQNZ}.py
instrument: all 15 records per arm; each guarded arm: >= 99% of its trades' signal candles pass the guard offline (load_pair, same non-zero rolling median), >= 10% of its control's trades fail it (the guard binds), trades in both halves, 0 position adds; each reversion null (s4k): agree share within 0.05 of cs_aro's. Fail -> that question INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read
